universe: All locally present SH/SZ ordinary A-share .day files, including stale files; NOT proven complete historical listed/delisted population
data: TDX raw OHLCV/amount, locally rebuilt Hithink multiplicative factors; every utilized raw OHLC row reconciled before a stock is admitted
lag_note: S1 remembers a 15-bar base for up to three bars; maximum information age 18 sessions, below 20
baseline: C > previous5 high; V/previous10 mean >=1.5; (C-L)/(H-L)>=0.65; C>O; previous10 mean amount>=100000000; latest15 stock bars consecutive in market calendar
s1: baseline AND one of t-1,t-2,t-3 had prior15 range/mean close<=0.20
s2: baseline AND previous close/previous15 maximum close-1<=-0.12 AND min(low[t-3:t])>=min(low[t-6:t-3])
chip_ablation: Each shape separately AND prior15 volume allocated to typical-price above C <=20%; not actual chip distribution
sampling: A common B0 event bank; per stock after an admitted event ignore following 5 market sessions; subgroup labels fixed at signal close; arms may overlap and must not be summed
entry: next market session open; no forward entry after missing/suspended next-session bar; skip indicative board-limit open or one-price entry; historical ST/IPO limits remain unknown
exit: close of entry session+h-1, h>=2 so no same-day sale; if absent or at indicative limit-down close roll to next observed bar close, max 5 extra market sessions; no forced end-of-data liquidation
limit_model: Indicative 10% ordinary/20% STAR-ChiNext, price reference from prior raw close * prior factor / current factor; 0.3pp tolerance. Historical ST and special-IPO restrictions NOT certified
cost_note: Pure proportional hypothetical total costs; not date-specific actual taxes, minimum commissions, impact, or portfolio net PnL
fail_closed: special unsupported corporate-action symbols from prior audit
calendar gaps in signal feature window
bounds: No historic industry members, so no fake sector backtest
No RPS or grid search in this round
No personal holding/trading changes or remote writes
All dates have prior project exposure; no untouched out-of-sample claim
Do not promote a shape solely on user-selected case fit
decision: Report coverage and baseline-relative evidence; retain negative or inconclusive result; do not deploy a strategy from this event study
